When someone goes to the state for welfare assistance, the individual’s needs are put into the CarePortal, which sends out the information to all the organizations — religious, charitable, business — that are participants in Hope Florida. 

These organizations (that are all exterior to government) can then respond to the needs.  This both saves taxpayer dollars and provides much better help.  Many of the people who have been served have eliminated their need for government assistance entirely.

The new initiative announced at the pastors forum will help supercharge the use of CarePortal, which has already served more than 72,000 Floridians.

Now, with the Florida Chamber underwriting the costs, more and more churches will be able to join the cause.

By linking those in need to resources exterior to government, CarePortal is the central node of Hope Florida and a big reason why tens of thousands have eliminated or reduced their need for public assistance.
